prompt: Create a polished anime-style half-body portrait of a cheerful schoolgirl character on a pure black background. She has very long bright golden blonde hair with thick layered bangs, loose hair flowing down her back, and one high side ponytail sweeping to the right. Her eyes are large vivid emerald green, with a happy open-mouth smile, light blush on both cheeks, and clean black line art. Pose her facing the viewer in a confident friendly stance: her left hand raised beside her face making a V peace sign, her right hand resting on her hip, shoulders slightly angled. Dress her in a Japanese school uniform: a fitted royal blue blazer with exactly 5 visible gold hexagonal buttons total, counted as 2 on the raised left sleeve cuff, 1 on the front center of the blazer, and 2 on the right sleeve cuff; underneath include a white collared shirt, tan sweater vest with ribbed V-neck trim, a purple necktie with diagonal gold stripes, and a green pleated skirt visible at the bottom. Add a distinctive red chemical-structure hair accessory above the side ponytail: a thin red stem from the hair leading to two connected hexagonal molecular rings with small glowing red node dots, plus the red letters “NH” on the right side. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with smooth gradients, glossy highlights in hair and eyes, subtle fabric folds, accurate hands, and a clean high-resolution square composition centered on the character. No extra background elements, no watermark, no additional text except the “NH” on the hair ornament.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格半身肖像，主角是一位在纯黑色背景下显得活泼开朗的女学生。她拥有一头非常长的 明亮的金黄色 头发，留着厚实的层次感刘海，长发垂在背后，右侧扎着一个高马尾。她有着一双明亮生动的 翡翠绿色 大眼睛，张嘴微笑着，双颊带着淡淡的红晕，线条清晰利落。让她以自信友好的姿态面向观众：左手举在脸旁比出 V 字手势，右手叉腰，双肩微微倾斜。为她穿上日本校服：一件合身的宝蓝色西装外套，总共可见 5 枚金色的六角形纽扣，分布为左侧袖口 2 枚，外套正前方 1 枚，右侧袖口 2 枚；内搭白色衬衫、带有罗纹 V 领的棕褐色毛衣背心、紫色斜纹金条领带，底部可见绿色百褶裙。在侧马尾上方添加一个独特的红色化学结构发饰：从头发延伸出一根细细的红色杆，连接着两个带有红色发光节点的六角形分子环，右侧带有红色字母“NH”。采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格，色彩过渡平滑，头发和眼睛带有光泽感，衣物褶皱自然，手部刻画准确，构图为居中的高清正方形。背景简洁，无多余元素，无水印，除发饰上的“NH”外，不包含任何额外文字。
